tools.description:

tools.name: lookup_vehicle
tools.description:
Decodes a VIN, or walks the vehicle catalog for exact year, make, model and subModel values.

    A VIN gives the most exact result. Without one, year lists makes, year+make lists models
    (model names include the trim, for example CR-V EXL), and year+make+model lists subModels.

Call this first in every conversation. Returns the question to ask the user and which tools

    manage the account) or someone looking for quotes (auto, home, flood or term life in Tennessee).

tools.name: verify_client_code
tools.description:
Checks the 6 digit code from the client's email. On success returns client_session (valid 30
    minutes) for the account tools. Five tries per code. On failure, ask the client to check the
    newest email or start again with start_client_sign_in.

tools.description:

    the policy ids the other account tools use.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "start_client_sign_in" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_eligibility, update_quote, verify_client_code · Private data: verify_contact, update_quote, submit_quote, request_agent, start_client_sign_in, get_coverage_summary, get_document, get_claim_contacts, request_service_change · Public sink: check_eligibility, update_quote, submit_quote, request_agent, identify_user, start_client_sign_in, verify_client_code, bring_in_outside_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_eligibility, update_quote, verify_client_code · Private data: verify_contact, update_quote, submit_quote, request_agent, start_client_sign_in, get_coverage_summary, get_document, get_claim_contacts, request_service_change · Public sink: check_eligibility, update_quote, submit_quote, request_agent, identify_user, start_client_sign_in, verify_client_code, bring_in_outside_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
